drhp.business:
Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited (BCSSL) is a steel processing centre that purchases raw steel coils and converts them into value-added processed steel products — slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks — sold to OEMs and ODMs. The company generated revenue from operations of ₹12,668.18 million in FY2026 and ₹3,970.80 million in Q1 FY2027.

BCSSL operates as an intermediary between primary steel producers and end-users. For the home and commercial appliances sector, it processes coated steel coils and hot-rolled steel coils into processed steel products. For the general engineering sector, it processes non-coated and galvanised plain coils into blanks used in automotive manufacturing, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, electrical equipment and ventilation systems. Beyond processing, the company provides logistics and inventory management, offering just-in-time delivery to customers across urban and remote locations.

Revenue channels are ODMs, OEMs and Others. The company served 178 customers in FY2026, 261 in FY2025, 252 in FY2024 and 225 in Q1 FY2027, spanning consumer durables, home appliances, electrical equipment, automotive, HVAC and refrigeration, electronics, industrial engineering, infrastructure, renewable energy and FMCG packaging. Named customers include Haier Appliances India, IFB Refrigeration, Dixon Electro Manufacturing, Amber Enterprises India, Western Refrigeration, PG Technoplast, EPack Durable and Kruger Ventilation.

BCSSL operates four facilities — Wada and Bhiwandi (Maharashtra), Ghiloth (Rajasthan) and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) — covering 42,209 square meters in aggregate. All facilities are ISO 9001:2015 certified for processing, marketing and supply of processed steel products; the Ghiloth and Sri City facilities carry GEM-4 green facility certification. Aggregate installed capacity stood at 1,23,153 MTPA on an annualised basis for Q1 FY2027, with a CAGR of approximately 23.83% between FY2024 and FY2026. Since 2021, the company has been an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (JSWSCPL), from whom it procures a substantial portion of raw materials. As of June 30, 2026, the workforce comprised 160 permanent and 4 retainership employees.

risks: We are substantially dependent on a single supplier, JSW Steel Coated Products Limited and/or its holding Company (“JSWSCPL”), for the supply of steel coils, which constitute a key raw material for our operations.

This high level of supplier concentration exposes us to significant risks, and any disruption in the supply of steel coils from JSWSCPL could materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Under this arrangement, we procure steel coils from JSWSCPL and undertake further value-added processing using high-precision engineering and machinery to manufacture processed steel products, which are supplied to OEMs and ODMs in the home and commercial appliances and general engineering sectors.

These customers require processed steel products that meet specific technical and quality specifications, and our ability to meet such requirements in a timely and cost-effective manner is closely linked to the continuity of supplies from JSWSCPL.

Any adverse change in our relationship with JSWSCPL, including reduction in supply volumes, changes in commercial terms, modification, non-renewal or termination of our authorised service partner status, or operational disruptions at JSWSCPL, could adversely affect our production schedules, increase our raw material costs, delay customer deliveries and negatively impact our revenue and profitability.

Further, as an authorised service partner of JSWSCPL, we are subject to restrictions relating to the procurement of galvanized plain coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets, colour-coated coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets, and galvalume plain coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets from suppliers other than JSWSCPL.
These restrictions limit our ability to diversify our supplier base for such steel products.

If we were to source such products from alternative suppliers, we may risk losing our authorised service partner status with JSWSCPL, which could significantly impair our sourcing arrangements, customer relationships and business model.

overview.business_model:
Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited (BCSSL) is a steel processing centre that purchases raw steel coils and converts them into value-added processed steel products — slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks — sold to OEMs and ODMs. The company generated revenue from operations of ₹12,668.18 million in FY2026 and ₹3,970.80 million in Q1 FY2027.

BCSSL operates as an intermediary between primary steel producers and end-users. For the home and commercial appliances sector, it processes coated steel coils and hot-rolled steel coils into processed steel products. For the general engineering sector, it processes non-coated and galvanised plain coils into blanks used in automotive manufacturing, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, electrical equipment and ventilation systems. Beyond processing, the company provides logistics and inventory management, offering just-in-time delivery to customers across urban and remote locations.

Revenue channels are ODMs, OEMs and Others. The company served 178 customers in FY2026, 261 in FY2025, 252 in FY2024 and 225 in Q1 FY2027, spanning consumer durables, home appliances, electrical equipment, automotive, HVAC and refrigeration, electronics, industrial engineering, infrastructure, renewable energy and FMCG packaging. Named customers include Haier Appliances India, IFB Refrigeration, Dixon Electro Manufacturing, Amber Enterprises India, Western Refrigeration, PG Technoplast, EPack Durable and Kruger Ventilation.

BCSSL operates four facilities — Wada and Bhiwandi (Maharashtra), Ghiloth (Rajasthan) and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) — covering 42,209 square meters in aggregate. All facilities are ISO 9001:2015 certified for processing, marketing and supply of processed steel products; the Ghiloth and Sri City facilities carry GEM-4 green facility certification. Aggregate installed capacity stood at 1,23,153 MTPA on an annualised basis for Q1 FY2027, with a CAGR of approximately 23.83% between FY2024 and FY2026. Since 2021, the company has been an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (JSWSCPL), from whom it procures a substantial portion of raw materials. As of June 30, 2026, the workforce comprised 160 permanent and 4 retainership employees.
overview.business_overview:
We are a steel processing centre engaged in the business of converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products. Our core competencies include precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing, and embossing of steel coils into slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks (collectively referred to as “Processed Steel Products”). We cater to a diversified customer base comprising Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs).

Our Company, being a Steel Processing Centre (“SPC”), operate as an intermediary between primary steel producers and end-users by providing value-added processing services. For the home and commercial appliances sector, we process coated steel coils and hot-rolled steel coils into Processed Steel Products used in the manufacture of various appliances. For the general engineering sector, we undertake specialized processing of non-coated and galvanised plain coils into blanks, used in automotive manufacturing, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, electrical equipment, and ventilation systems. In addition to manufacturing Processed Steel Products, we also perform logistics and inventory management functions. By maintaining adequate inventory levels and offering just-in-time delivery solutions, we ensure timely and efficient supply of processed steel products to customers across urban as well as remote locations, thereby enhancing supply chain efficiency

One of the Promoters of our Company, Mr. Vijaykumar Himatrai Gupta, commenced operations in 1983 as a steel trader under the sole proprietorship M/s. Bombay Steels. In 2012, the business expanded into steel processing with the establishment of the Bhiwandi facility, followed by the execution of a service partnership agreement with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (“JSWSCPL”) in 2018. Subsequently, on January 29, 2021, our Company entered into a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the running business of M/s. Bombay Steels on a going-concern basis. This acquisition consolidated over four decades of trading and processing experience into the operations of our Company. Thereafter, our Company has entered into a phase of rapid expansion and added steel processing facilities across key manufacturing regions of India. We expanded our operations by establishing new manufacturing facilities in the West, North and South of India. Our steel processing facilities are strategically located across key industrial regions in India, enabling us to serve a wide spectrum of industries with efficiency and just in time deliveries. For further details see ‘Our Business – Manufacturing Facilities’ on page 261.

Since 2021, our Company has been an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products Limited and/or its holding Company (“JSWSCPL”), pursuant to an agreement for the regular supply of steel coils. We procure steel coils from JSWSCPL as well as other suppliers and process them using advanced engineering techniques and high-precision machinery to manufacture Processed Steel Products. Our long-standing and strong supplier relationships ensure stability and reliability in sourcing, enabling us to efficiently and consistently meet customer requirements. (Source: CareEdge

We are a multi-location steel processing centre with manufacturing facilities located at Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh. Our facilities are equipped with steel processing infrastructure, including slitting lines, cut-to-length lines, shearing lines, and embossing lines, designed to achieve operational precision and efficiency. These manufacturing facilities are spread across four strategically located sites in India, aggregating a total area of 42,209 square meters, and are ISO 9001:2015 certified for the processing, marketing, and supply of Processed Steel Products. Further, our Ghiloth facility in Rajasthan and Sri City in facility Andhra Pradesh has been recognized as a GEM- 4 certified green facility.

The locations of our manufacturing facilities have been selected with reference to proximity to customer delivery points. Certain facilities are located near the manufacturing locations of customers such as Western Refrigeration Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited, PG Technoplast Private Limited, EPack Durable Limited, Kruger Ventilation Industries (India) Private Limited, among others. This proximity enables reduction in logistics time and transportation costs, facilitates operational efficiencies, and supports timely fulfilment of customer requirements. In addition, the clustering of certain facilities within the same state allows for inter-facility movement of materials, thereby reducing freight time and costs as components undergo sequential processing.

We operate with an aggregate installed processing capacity of 1,23,153 MTPA, computed on a quarterly basis for Fiscal 2027, across slitting, cut-to-length, shearing and embossing operations, as of June 30, 2026. Our installed capacity has increased at a compound annual growth rate (“CAGR”) of approximately 23.83% between Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2026, reflecting our continued focus on capacity expansion and operational scalability. For further details see ‘Our Business – Installed Capacity and Capacity Utilization’ on page 261. Further, our long-standing authorised partnership with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited since 2021 provides us with reliable access to quality raw materials and supports our ability to service a diversified customer base, positioning us well for sustained growth in the steel processing industry. We have established long-standing relationships with a diverse set of customers. Our focus on quality, value proposition, timely delivery of our products and the price competitiveness of our offerings has enabled us to maintain long-term relationships with our customers. In Fiscal Years 2026, 2025 and 2024, as well as for the three months period ended June 30, 2026, we served 178, 261, 252 and 225 and customers, respectively. These customers span multiple industries, including consumer durables and home appliances, electrical equipment and components, automotive and auto components, HVAC and refrigeration, electronics and electrical manufacturing services, industrial engineering and capital goods, steel processing and metal fabrication, infrastructure, renewable energy and power equipment, FMCG and packaging, as well as general manufacturing and industrial trading enterprises. Such diversification of our customer base across industries reduces our dependence on any single customer or industry segment. (Source: CareEdge Report) Our customer-centric approach enables us to provide tailored solutions that align with both functional and aesthetic expectations, and just in time deliveries of Processed Steel Products aligns with the requirements of our customers. Our customer base includes several OEMs and ODMs operating in India, including Haier Appliances India Private Limited IFB Refrigeration Limited, Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited, Western Refrigeration Private Limited, PG Technoplast Private Limited, EPack Durable Limited Kruger Ventilation Industries (India) Private Limited, Elegant Coatings Private Limited and Magnum MI Steel Private Limited.

Our Promoters, Board of Directors, and senior management have been instrumental in the growth of our business and have enabled us to capitalize on market opportunities and better serve our customers, with collective experience spanning operations, business development, and customer relationship management. Our Promoter and Chairman-cum-Whole-Time Director, Mr. Vijaykumar Himatrai Gupta, has over 40 years of experience in the steel industry and provides guidance in formulating our long-term business strategies and business development initiatives, having played a pivotal role in steering the growth and development of our Company. Our Promoter and Managing Director, Mr. Nitin Vijaykumar Gupta, has approximately 20 years of experience in the steel industry and is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Company, as well as providing guidance on strategy formulation, business development, and customer relationships. Our workforce is a critical asset to our operations and comprised 160 permanent employees and 4 retainership employees as of June 30, 2026, who form the backbone of our business by driving innovation, ensuring quality, and maintaining the standards expected by our customers.

Our Market Opportunity

As per the CareEdge Report, there exists a substantial market opportunity for our Company, which can be clearly demonstrated from the following:

Role of Steel Processing Centres:

Steel Processing Centres (“SPCs”) in India are witnessing significant growth, driven by rising steel consumption across diverse end-use sectors such as automotive, construction, infrastructure and manufacturing. As India continues to accelerate its industrialisation and infrastructure development, SPCs are emerging as a critical link between large-scale steel producers and end-users, providing essential services including steel slitting, cut-to-length, blanking, splitting, inventory management, and timely distribution. These services enable industries to access steel in the precise forms and quantities required, thereby improving efficiency, reducing waste, and optimising supply chains.

The growing demand for steel arising from infrastructure development, supported by government initiatives and urbanisation, has contributed to the increasing relevance of SPCs. In parallel, expansion in the automotive and manufacturing sectors has resulted in greater demand for processed steel products that meet specific technical and dimensional requirements. By customising steel products and reducing dependence on in-house processing by end-users, SPCs support improved manufacturing efficiency, reduced material wastage and optimised supply chains. The increasing adoption of just-in-time (“JIT”) delivery models, particularly in the automotive and consumer durables sectors, has further reinforced the importance of SPCs in ensuring timely availability of processed steel inputs.

Growth of Key Service Segments:

• Cut to Length: The market size of Cut to Length service type grew at a CAGR of 8.3% from CY20 to CY25, reaching a market size of USD 1,707 million by CY25. It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 6.8% from CY26 to CY30 reaching a market size of USD 2,337 million by CY30.

• Slitting: The market size of Slitting service type grew at a CAGR of 8.7% from CY20 to CY25, reaching a market size of USD 1,501 million by CY25. It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 7.2% from CY26 to CY30 reaching a market size of USD 2,095 million by CY30.

• Blanking: The market size of the Blanking service type grew at a CAGR of 8.7% from CY20 to CY25 reaching a market size of USD 892 million by CY25. It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 7.4% from CY26 to CY30 reaching market size of USD 1,250 million by CY30.

• Splitting: The market size of Splitting service type grew at a CAGR of 8.8% from CY20 to CY25 reaching a market size of USD 379 million by CY25. It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 7.4% from CY26 to CY30 reaching market size of USD 531 million by CY30.

• Others: The market size of Other service types including shearing, embossing, and surface treatment such as pickling and oiling, galvanizing, nickel plating, chrome plating, phosphating, etc. grew at a CAGR of 6.4% from CY20 to CY25 reaching a market size of USD 344 million by CY25. It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 5.0% from CY26 to CY30 reaching market size of USD 433 million by CY30.

The steady growth across all service segments highlights the increasing importance of SPCs in supporting India’s industrial ecosystem.

Key Drivers of Opportunity:

• Growing Demand from Construction and Automotive Industries: The construction and automotive sectors are major consumers of steel, driving the demand for Steel Processing Centres. Steel is critical for applications such as structural framing in construction and car components in automotive production. As both industries expand, the need for Steel Processing Centres to supply customised steel products, with reduced lead times and processing, continues to rise.

• Technological Advancements in Steelmaking: Technological innovations are reshaping the steel industry, enabling more efficient steel production and processing. These advancements lead to lower production costs, making steel more accessible for various industries. The development of new equipment and steelmaking processes is also enhancing the productivity of Steel Processing Centres, enabling them to serve their customers more efficiently and cost-effectively.

Its role in heavy industries, construction, and machinery is expanding as demand for robust, temperature-resistant materials rises. Steel Processing Centres are essential for supplying specialised steel products, contributing to their growing market presence.

As the global demand for steel rises, centres are increasingly competing for customers worldwide. This global reach encourages service centres to improve operational efficiency, adopt advanced technologies, and offer better services at competitive prices, ultimately benefiting customers.

The establishment of new centres in emerging markets allows them to cater to local manufacturing needs. Additionally, the growing preference for steel in industries such as mining, construction, and chemicals further drives the demand for Steel Processing Centre services.

• Expansion of India's Consumer Electronics and Appliances Sector Driving Steel Demand: The consumer electronics and appliances sector in India is witnessing significant expansion, fuelled by rising incomes, technological innovation, and growing domestic demand. As the country positions itself as a major player in the global market for products like smartphones, white goods, and air conditioners, the need for high-quality materials, particularly steel, continues to rise. Steel plays a crucial role in the production of key components such as frames and internal structures, which are integral to the manufacturing of these consumer products. This increased demand for durable, reliable materials supports the broader industrial landscape.

summary.business:
Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited (BCSSL) is a steel processing centre that purchases raw steel coils and converts them into value-added processed steel products — slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks — sold to OEMs and ODMs. The company generated revenue from operations of ₹12,668.18 million in FY2026 and ₹3,970.80 million in Q1 FY2027.

BCSSL operates as an intermediary between primary steel producers and end-users. For the home and commercial appliances sector, it processes coated steel coils and hot-rolled steel coils into processed steel products. For the general engineering sector, it processes non-coated and galvanised plain coils into blanks used in automotive manufacturing, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, electrical equipment and ventilation systems. Beyond processing, the company provides logistics and inventory management, offering just-in-time delivery to customers across urban and remote locations.

Revenue channels are ODMs, OEMs and Others. The company served 178 customers in FY2026, 261 in FY2025, 252 in FY2024 and 225 in Q1 FY2027, spanning consumer durables, home appliances, electrical equipment, automotive, HVAC and refrigeration, electronics, industrial engineering, infrastructure, renewable energy and FMCG packaging. Named customers include Haier Appliances India, IFB Refrigeration, Dixon Electro Manufacturing, Amber Enterprises India, Western Refrigeration, PG Technoplast, EPack Durable and Kruger Ventilation.

BCSSL operates four facilities — Wada and Bhiwandi (Maharashtra), Ghiloth (Rajasthan) and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) — covering 42,209 square meters in aggregate. All facilities are ISO 9001:2015 certified for processing, marketing and supply of processed steel products; the Ghiloth and Sri City facilities carry GEM-4 green facility certification. Aggregate installed capacity stood at 1,23,153 MTPA on an annualised basis for Q1 FY2027, with a CAGR of approximately 23.83% between FY2024 and FY2026. Since 2021, the company has been an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (JSWSCPL), from whom it procures a substantial portion of raw materials. As of June 30, 2026, the workforce comprised 160 permanent and 4 retainership employees.

risks.body:
- We are substantially dependent on a single supplier, JSW Steel Coated Products Limited and/or its holding Company (“JSWSCPL”), for the supply of steel coils, which constitute a key raw material for our operations.
- This high level of supplier concentration exposes us to significant risks, and any disruption in the supply of steel coils from JSWSCPL could materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

- These customers require processed steel products that meet specific technical and quality specifications, and our ability to meet such requirements in a timely and cost-effective manner is closely linked to the continuity of supplies from JSWSCPL.
- Any adverse change in our relationship with JSWSCPL, including reduction in supply volumes, changes in commercial terms, modification, non-renewal or termination of our authorised service partner status, or operational disruptions at JSWSCPL, could adversely affect our production schedules, increase our raw material costs, delay customer deliveries and negatively impact our revenue and profitability.
- Further, as an authorised service partner of JSWSCPL, we are subject to restrictions relating to the procurement of galvanized plain coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets, colour-coated coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets, and galvalume plain coils/sheets and corrugated/profiled sheets from suppliers other than JSWSCPL.
- These restrictions limit our ability to diversify our supplier base for such steel products.
- If we were to source such products from alternative suppliers, we may risk losing our authorised service partner status with JSWSCPL, which could significantly impair our sourcing arrangements, customer relationships and business model.
